newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks rise 10.93 points in the week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks rise 10.93 points in the week.

text.p: Bahrain shares were little changed in the week to Thursday with the index creeping up 10.93 points from better performance in banking and financial stocks, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
The index climbed to 1,549.85 points from 1,538.92 points the previous week.
Trading volume dropped to 4.3 million shares worth 1.2 million dinars ($3.2 million) from 6.4 million shares worth three million dinars a week earlier, it added.
Shares of 21 firms out of 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 126 transactions.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
